commands.review_summary:
The branch adds a default-disabled `core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` doctor lint check with read-only cron store and migration receipt readers plus focused tests.

PR surface: Source +247, Tests +158. Total +405 across 7 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review finding by source inspection: `HealthCheck` lacks `defaultEnabled` while the new object adds it, and the correct selection metadata type is `SplitHealthCheckInput`. The product change itself is a new opt-in doctor lint surface rather than a bug reproduction.

target.title: Expose legacy cron store doctor lint findings
target.body:
## Summary
- add default-disabled `core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` structured lint findings for legacy cron JSON stores, legacy run logs, quarantined rows, SQLite projection backfills, notify fallback, and stale dreaming payloads
- add structured dry-run repair effects for the existing cron repair path: migrate/archive legacy stores, import run logs, quarantine invalid rows, normalize store shape, backfill SQLite projections, migrate `notify`, and rewrite stale dreaming payloads
- keep selected lint and dry-run preview on read-only state inspection paths so they do not create or migrate the shared state DB
- keep real mutation in the existing legacy `doctor --fix` cron contribution; structured non-dry-run repair reports `skipped`

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` is unchanged; this check runs with `--only core/doctor/legacy-cron-store` or `--all`.

## ClawSweeper P1 follow-up
- Fixed selected lint/dry-run preview using writable shared-state DB open paths.
- Added regression coverage proving `collectLegacyCronStoreHealthFindings` and `collectLegacyCronStoreRepairEffects` do not create the shared state DB while previewing legacy cron state.

## PR surface
- 7 files changed, +707/-4 from `main`.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts` (118 tests)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/commands/doctor/cron/index.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/migration-ledger.ts src/cron/store.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/commands/doctor/cron/index.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts src/commands/doctor/cron/migration-ledger.ts src/cron/store.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Not completed locally
- `pnpm tsgo:core` and `pnpm tsgo:core:test` timed out on Windows after 5 minutes without diagnostics.
- Earlier source CLI proof using throwaway `--profile doctor-cron-proof-*` timed out because each invocation rebuilt the dirty-tree runtime; generated proof profiles were removed.
